evidence.quote: Python MCP Server abstracting the official mermaid-cli for ease of use

result.notes: Mermaid CLI (mmdc) is an open-source command-line tool (npm package / Docker image) that renders Mermaid diagram definitions to SVG/PNG/PDF locally. There is no hosted vendor API or auth of any kind — it runs entirely offline as a local process. No official MCP server exists for mermaid-cli itself; several community-built MCP wrappers (Python and JS) exist that shell out to mmdc, but none are vendor-published by mermaid-js. Note: this is distinct from the commercial 'Mermaid Chart' SaaS product (mermaidchart.com), which does have its own official hosted MCP server — that is a different product from this open-source CLI and was not evaluated here. Buildability verdict is for mermaid-cli as a local agent skill/tool invocation, not a hosted API integration.
result.one_liner: Mermaid CLI (mmdc) is an open-source command-line tool that renders Mermaid diagram text definitions into SVG, PNG, or PDF files.
